categories.name: Shipping tips
categories.description: Practical notes on packing, labels and cut-offs.

posts.title: West Gate becomes our fourteenth hub
posts.excerpt: A new customs hub brings next-day coverage to 92 percent.
posts.content:
Our fourteenth hub opened at West Gate this month, with customs clearance, a bonded store and twelve loading docks. Night trailers from the Central Depot now reach the western ports in under six hours.

With West Gate running, 92 percent of addresses in the country can receive standard parcels the next day. Shippers in the west can book pickups until 17:00 from Monday.

posts.title: A five-point checklist for pallets that arrive intact
posts.excerpt: Wrap, label, stack and measure before the driver arrives.
posts.content:
Stack heavy boxes at the bottom and keep every box inside the pallet edge. Wrap the load at least five times around, including the pallet itself, so the film holds the boxes to the wood.

Label two sides, not the top, and measure the height including the pallet. Pallets over 1.8 metres need to be booked as oversize; our drivers measure every pallet at pickup.

posts.title: Peak season cut-offs for November and December
posts.excerpt: Book capacity early and plan around the holiday break.
posts.content:
From mid-November parcel volumes double at most hubs. Shippers who send more than 200 parcels a day should book peak capacity with their regional desk before 31 October.

The last next-day pickup before the holidays is 29 December at 17:00. Our control room stays open through the break, and deliveries restart on 4 January.
